goal: Disconnect HTTP clients that fail to finish sending a request within a deadline
Prevents slow clients from trickling bytes to hold RPC connection slots and lock out legitimate calls
agreement: Unaddressed objection: loose test assertion could hide premature socket reclamation (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it prevents slowloris-style connection slot exhaustion on the internal HTTP server
Slow unauthenticated clients trickling bytes can no longer occupy all connection slots indefinitely
Fixes a denial-of-service vulnerability that can block legitimate RPC clients
